notes.title: New Additions And Bug Fixes! V0.1.453 - V0.1.455
notes.notes:
V0.1.453



Bug Fixes:

Made the AT gun and Bofors more stable after finding more issues 

Tutorial objective text would sometimes get cut off 

V2 when hitting friendly tank with new armor rear hit logic would glitch out 

Prevent spamming oil wells

Tutorial would glitch when spamming defensive pos on already built buildings 

Fixed HQ radar visual



I've received much feedback regarding in-game unit UI, I have updated the look and way it acts

A much softer blue will be used to prevent eye strain and the unit UIs scale better now no matter how you are zoomed. This counts for all progress and tip bars in the game as well. Unit UI healthbar width scales according to health and all unit UIs are also much closer to units now.



V0.1.454

New things: 

New healthbars, tips and other in-game text scaling 

Map boundary lines 

Map boundary enforcement - no sending units or building things outside of boundaries. 

Left shift + click to build 5 units at a time at any building 

Smarter Pz4 behavior in tutorial, will chase anything you throw at it etc. Different AI than skirmish AI that handles it

Improved P-47 visual



 Bug fixes: 

Windows Accessibility Pointer Size Glitch - Cursor size now increases or decreases when entering into the game or exiting to adjust size 

When adjusting camera rotation and using minimap to pan, camera would zoom in or out by itself, no longer the case 

Supply depot team color strip visual glitch 

Trying to place a building and clicking UI caused issues like building indicator not going away





V0.1.455



New things: 

Feedback system

Bofors and AT gun now knock down trees

More tips in loading screen

Loading screen is now fully translated

Bunker falls a bit faster during destruction

Planes that can be called in for support now arrive faster and scout plane is in general a bit faster as well

 Bug fixes: 

Mouse click not working after cancelling buildings

Building visualizers can persist if some bugs occur or external software cause issues, should no longer be the case

In some instances artillery call in explosion particles didn't get reset

notes.title: DEVELOPER UPDATE #1
notes.notes:

• Improved unit dynamic target selection
• Fixed vehicle explosion sizes
• New vehicle destruction effects(metal pieces that fly in the air)
• Fixed bug where in some cases vehicle HMG keeps firing after death
• Added tooltip hover system
